entities.title: Processes written down where agents read them
entities.summary: General software development processes, written down as conventions, templates and tools that any repository can copy or link to.
entities.problem: Most of the builders on the owner's teams are now agents, and an agent follows a process only if the process is written down where the agent will read it.
audience: Teams whose builders are mostly agents, and the people who direct them
Repositories that adopt a convention by copying it or linking to it
entities.outcome: Each process is written down once, here, not tied to any one system; a repository that adopts it copies what it needs and links to what it references, so that there is one copy to drift.
nonGoals: Conventions tied to one system: those belong in that system's repository.
